app.name: Waste overview
app.summary: Every kind of waste side by side, with how many days until it goes out, from a calendar.
app.input_calendar_hint: The calendar with the collection days (Waste Collection Schedule, a local calendar, ...).
app.tile_example: Paper in 2 days · Residual in 9 days
app.days_hint: How far ahead to look for collections.
app.drop_after_hint: From this hour on, a collection of today makes way for the next one of its kind. 24 keeps it all day.
app.match_hint: A word in the calendar's event, such as Papier or Gelber. Leave all kinds empty to show every event name as a kind of its own.
app.label_hint: What the tile calls it. Empty takes the event's name.
